status: prospective optional opt-in coverage; not requester assertions or render gates
chosen_from: independent general knowledge and original costume design
cooccurrence_goal: Read all six relations on the same photographed subject in one coherent frame.
meaning_boundaries: Color, body proportion and exposure are authorial realizations, not definitions of these relations. The design is an original combination and does not claim to reproduce a particular existing character.

relations.observable_relation: Two high side tails connect to separate roots, each bracketed by one rigid open rectangular frame.
relations.baseline_evidence: a rigid open rectangular hair frame brackets the root of each tail

relations.observable_relation: Two ear pieces form a wearable headset; a short boom joins the left earpiece and terminates by the mouth corner.
relations.baseline_evidence: a short boom curving from her left earpiece toward the corner of her mouth

relations.observable_relation: A standing collar and narrow front tie link to a sleeveless tapered bodice.
relations.baseline_evidence: connects a standing collar to a sleeveless tapered bodice with a narrow front tie

relations.observable_relation: Forearm sleeves are separate garment pieces ending below the upper arms with space to the bodice armholes.
relations.baseline_evidence: Separate ribbed forearm sleeves end below the upper arms, leaving a clear separation from the bodice armholes

relations.observable_relation: A waist-mounted belt supports a pleated skirt whose lower edge has a translucent stepped layer.
relations.baseline_evidence: A waist-mounted belt supports a short pleated skirt with a translucent stepped hem

relations.observable_relation: The tops of thigh-high stockings remain below the skirt edge, leaving a readable interval between separate garment pieces.
relations.baseline_evidence: Opaque thigh-high stockings stop below the skirt hem, leaving a visible interval between the two garment edges
